# Synthetic failure capture after the partner board-place wording (#172)

Source commit d4fa8fed86bb4300718ba0307c3776d513b20e55 (prompt wording shared by both strategies: `TASK_INSTRUCTIONS_V2`, the memo extraction prompt and Jev's referent and decision instructions now separate a partner's place on their own board from shape features). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the adopted failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67 capture, records differ only at 153 leaves: 15 run IDs, 15 instruction-source hash leaves (`judgment/instructions.mjs`, `local-grounding/extract.ts` and `decision/jev-decision.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios), the derived `identity.prompts` digest, and, in `cache_read_failed`, the request text and the hashes derived from it. The 44 text leaves (Luna task and extraction messages and Jev instructions in the paired-replay evidence) each equal the previous text with exactly the #172 wording change. The 78 hash leaves are the call, HTTP, wiring-stage, replay-tape and paired-replay hashes of those requests and the two Jev payload digests (`actionInputs`, `humanReferent`). The leaf-path set (6917 leaves) and the input-material digests (`actionMaterial`, `humanMaterial`) are unchanged, so behavior, schema, failure, clocks, policy, calls/sends and storage are unchanged. In the metadata only `baseCommit`, `fixtureSha256` and the source hashes of those three files change (72 source files, all checked against the commit's files). Existing 3 run-ID exclusions are unchanged.

Earlier fixture directories remain byte-identical. Only the current provenance target URL and its baseCommit literal move. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
